title: Ghostwriter API token entry uses a plain text field

evidence.quote: Gets the Ghostwriter API key from Keychain

reasoning: The Ghostwriter token is a credential stored in Keychain, but the entry alert displays typed characters in a plain TextField. That unnecessarily exposes the token to shoulder surfing, screenshots, and screen recording during setup.
reproduction: Open Ghostwriter settings, tap Set API Token, and type a token. The token is visible as normal text in the alert.
recommendation: Use SecureField for token entry and keep the existing masked display after save. Consider disabling autocorrection/text learning for the secure field as well.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover repository key storage behavior only for OpenAI keys and do not inspect UI controls used for Ghostwriter token entry.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a SwiftUI inspection or snapshot test that verifies the API Token alert uses a secure input control rather than a plain TextField.
